QuestInfo.name: Finding Emergency Supplies
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p3001008##k, the quartermaster, at the #r#m401000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001008##k asks you to obtain #r#t4033573##k items for soldiers to eat. They can be obtained from #r#o2400103##k monsters at the #b#m401030000##k.
QuestInfo.2: The soldiers can have a real meal now!

0.0: I'm #b#p3001008##k, the dude in charge of supplies for the troops in the Heliseum Reclamation HQ.
0.1: #bMaroon#k over there is my twin brother. Oh, and that's my younger sister #bKarin#k.
0.2: Hopefully you can tell me apart from my twin bro over there, #b#p3001009##k. We both chopped off one of our horns to help people tell us apart, but it doesn't seem to help.
0.3: I'm sure you already know, but a lot of the soldiers are near starving. You haven't been getting enough food these days also, right? That's why I figured you'd want to help.
0.4: Do you think maybe you could get some meat for us? There's monsters called #r#o2400103#s#k nearby that make killer steak. I think we need about #b40#k of them to feed everybody.\r\n#r#e(You will move to the quest map automatically upon accepting.)

yes.0: That's great. I'll just wait here.

no.0: You can't fight on an empty stomach. Shoot, now what will we do?

yes.0: Finally, I can stop boiling old boots. The soldiers are going to flip when they see this. #bEdea#k was looking for you, by the way.

item.0: Please bring me #b40#k #r#t4033573##k items from #r#o2400103##k monsters over at #b#m401030000##k. I don't think you got enough of them just yet.
